events.address: Madison Square Park, southeast corner near Fifth Avenue, Broadway and 23rd Street, New York, NY 10010
events.what_it_is: A free US Open fan experience with AI-powered tennis activations, live match viewing, an AI photo booth, serve-speed testing and ping-pong experiences.
events.what_is_free: Public access to the fan experience and its interactive activations is free. Official US Open merchandise is available separately for purchase.
events.caveats: IBM's official release says the activations are open to the public. The Sunday schedule runs through 7 PM. Merchandise is not included with admission.
events.practical_notes: Sunday, September 13 from 11 AM–7 PM. The men's singles final coverage begins at 2 PM. The activation is at the southeast corner of Madison Square Park near IBM's One Madison Avenue office.

events.what_it_is: A brownstone-inspired NYFW pop-up with a hair-and-makeup refresh station, an experiential photo booth, on-site legwear customization and complimentary coffee.
events.what_is_free: Entry is open to the public. Complimentary coffee, branded stickers and hand-embroidered personalization on purchased knee highs are advertised; the knee-high products themselves are sold on site.
events.caveats: The current event listing explicitly says the pop-up is open to the public. Merchandise from the tights vending machine is paid; customization is complimentary with the item. No approval or advance RSVP requirement is stated.
events.practical_notes: Sunday, September 13 from 12–5 PM at 188 Lafayette Street. This record relies on a current secondary event listing because an official standalone event page was not located in this pass.

occurrences.details: Free public fan experience; men's final coverage begins at 2 PM.
Open to the public; retail products are paid, with select complimentary experiences.
